description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Mordekaiser''' stores 45% of the post-mitigation damage he deals and 7.5% of the pre-mitigation damage he takes,「 reduced by 75% for non-champion sources, 」「 reduced to 11.25% of damage dealt and 1.875% of damage taken for non-champion sources, 」as ''Potential Shield'' on his secondary resource bar, up to [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 30% of his '''maximum''' health. The ''Potential Shield'' decays by 8 – 25 (based on level) every second after not dealing or taking damage for 1 second. While ''Indestructible'' is not on cooldown, the ''Potential Shield'' will not decay below a minimum of 5% of his '''maximum''' health, and it will be set to that amount when it comes off cooldown if it was previously below it.

The Potential Shield decays by 8 – 25 (based on level) every second after not dealing or taking damage for 1 second. While Indestructible is not on cooldown, the Potential Shield will not decay below a minimum of 5% of his maximum health, and it will be set to that amount when it comes off cooldown if it was previously below it.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Mordekaiser''' consumes his ''Potential Shield'' to grant himself a [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shield]] for the same amount for 4 seconds. The shield decays exponentially over the duration. ''Indestructible'' can be recast after 0.5 seconds while the shield is active.
description2.text: Active: Mordekaiser consumes his Potential Shield to grant himself a shield for the same amount for 4 seconds. The shield decays exponentially over the duration. Indestructible can be recast after 0.5 seconds while the shield is active.

description3.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Mordekaiser''' consumes the remaining shield, [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|healing]] for a portion of the amount.
description3.text: Recast: Mordekaiser consumes the remaining shield, healing for a portion of the amount.

notes.raw: * Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. * The recast will heal '''Mordekaiser''' for a minimum of 1.75 / 1.875 / 2 / 2.125 / 2.25% and up to 10.5 / 11.25 / 12 / 12.75 / 13.5% of his '''maximum''' health. ** It also effectively converts 15.75 / 16.875 / 18 / 19.125 / 20.25% of damage dealt and 2.625 / 2.8125 / 3 / 3.1875 / 3.375% of damage taken, reduced to 3.9375 / 4.2188 / 4.5 / 4.7813 / 5.0625% and 0.6563 / 0.7031 / 0.75 / 0.7969 / 0.8438% for non-champion sources respectively.
